revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261125 Delphi RTTI/LStr fold (default on, --no-delphi-fold / ?no-delphi-fold): threaded handler 395 (the retired SMACK_HUFF slot) runs _LStrClr/_LStrAsg/_FinalizeRecord/_FinalizeArray/_CopyRecord natively and writes EIP only to resume inside the same helper body (fallback after its first instruction, or a partial path at its own CALL) or falls through to the body RET; ordinary RET, no callback frame, invocation identity preserved. The host plumbs set_delphi_fold like set_smc_same_block. General callback ownership remains pending.
